items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The person that really influenced me was Mr. Weist. Because he took an interest in me he said, “you know look if you practice this... Just don’t think about it—hypnotize yourself.”

ctx.x: And this was the gentleman who was the drum major? And he had the Master’s degree from the University of Michigan in music? And he was teaching junior high school?
